This dentist office over-schedules the number patients.  It happens every time with this office.  I walked in 10 minutes early for my appointment but there were seven people in front of me.  There is no way that the dentist could be seven people behind after being open for only 3 to 4 hours.  It's only possible when too many patients are being scheduled for each hour.  After waiting 1 hour and 20 minutes to see the dentist, I got up and left.  I will never go back.  The patient's time is also valuable.  Please note, I have the witness of another patient who has also experienced this same issue with this dentist office.  If everyone shows up for their appointment with no cancellations, the office will be full.  In my opinion the over-scheduling of patients is not a good business practice for a dentist, considering the number of available dentist in Chiang Mai.

With such poor service, no wonder the business is not good.
